title: Design a brownfield workload-domain convergence into VCF 9.1
prompt:
Implement `ArchitectureClient.java` as a single-file Java client that produces the brownfield VMware Cloud Foundation architecture for the supplied estate. `TestMain` will call `ArchitectureClient.design(String inventoryJson)` and treat the returned string as the machine-checkable JSON artifact. Modify only `ArchitectureClient.java`; all other supplied files must remain unchanged.

Before implementing the client, research current Broadcom-published compatibility, interoperability, and supported-upgrade-path material for the inventoried versions, including the point-solution transition represented by Live Site Recovery and vSphere Replication. Record the sources consulted in an `xResearchConsulted` array in the artifact; each entry should contain a source title, URL, date consulted, and the architecture decision it informed.

Read `fixtures/estate-inventory.json` and `schema/migration-architecture-schema.json`.

Return one JSON object, with no prose or Markdown around it. The entire root object must conform to the SddcSpec schema in the VMware Cloud Foundation Installer API 9.1.0.0 contract. Model conversion/import of the existing workload domain into the named existing fleet, reuse the fixture's existing vCenter and NSX deployments, retain the supplied topology and validation settings, and add the brownfield architecture fields defined by `schema/migration-architecture-schema.json`. The management domain must remain `NO_CHANGE` and no management-domain component may appear in the migration plan.

Populate `xMigrationPlan` as a contiguous, ordered plan derived from the inventory and researched compatibility information. It must cover every candidate-workload-domain component by ID, state each component's source product and version, supported target product and version, complete supported upgrade path, final management state, migration method, and all technical gates that apply. Represent the grouped recovery convergence, the NSX-present VCF Installer convert/import operation, and the ordered fleet lifecycle groups without inventing an independent component-upgrade route. Include only gates required by the supported path.

Run `javac ArchitectureClient.java TestMain.java && java TestMain`.
network_notes: Live Broadcom research is required while solving; deterministic verification is fully local and does not contact a VMware endpoint.
